description: Land Title Settlement Department - Paraththa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530013 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (No. 67 of Block 08) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification.
